scenes.narration: The food we eat consists of a number of nutrients. A nutrient is a component of food that provides nourishment to the body for its growth and maintenance. Carbohydrates and fats give us energy. Proteins help us grow. Minerals and vitamins protect our body.
In the human body, nutrition has five steps. Step one is ingestion: the process by which food is taken in.
Step two is digestion: breaking down complex food into simpler absorbable molecules, so that it is easily absorbed in our body.
Step three is absorption: the digested food is taken up by the cells of our body. Step four is assimilation: the absorbed food is used by living cells for growth and other purposes.
Step five is egestion: the process by which undigested food is removed from the body.
